description: This file defines the UserMenuConfigurator class, which implements menu configuration logic for the OrangeHRM admin module. It primarily overrides the 'viewSystemUsers' screen in the current module context.

classes.name: UserMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration functionality for the admin module, specifically overriding screen settings for user management.
